adversarial.description: The evaluator inspected the actual red output rather than accepting a non-zero exit alone: all eleven new schema negatives unexpectedly produced the named [C12] PASS signal, while their existing paired positives remained PASS and older negatives remained FAIL. The resolved-to-open probe reached a successful compare invocation, then failed only because F1 was not present solely in reopened with the later evidence. This distinguishes the reported defects from setup, routing, syntax, or blanket-schema failure.
adversarial.result: PASS — twelve intended defects reproduced; no unrelated fixture or existing behavior failed.
adversarial.process_note: Single-session collapsed-role QA, disclosed in contract 085. The red state is the approved deliverable for this feature and is immediately consumed by dependent features 086/087 before branch publication.

final_verdict.summary: Feature 085 APPROVED. The 30-row issue #52 matrix is complete and assigns every atomic finding to features 086-089. Eleven schema negatives and one resolved-to-open CLI probe fail against the v0.9.0 implementation for their intended reasons, with exit code 1 and full output captured. Existing paired positives and pre-existing negatives remain correctly classified. No production remediation landed in this red TDD feature.
